editorial:
If you love big, loud action movies with Jackie Chan, Vanguard is right up your alley. The story follows a covert security company called Vanguard, which steps in to protect an accountant targeted by a deadly mercenary group. From the first scene, you get high-stakes chases, wild stunts, and a playful tone that keeps things fun rather than heavy. The characters are likable, and the team chemistry gives the movie a buddy-cop feel even when bullets fly. It is the kind of film you put on when you want pure entertainment without thinking too hard.

The action scenes are the real star, with car chases, fight sequences, and globe-trotting locations keeping the pace fast. Jackie Chan brings his usual charm and physical comedy, and the supporting cast keeps up well. On the downside, the story can feel messy at times, and some comedy does not always land. Still, fans of old-school action with modern polish will enjoy it.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the Vanguard team launches a daring rescue to free the accountant from the mercenary leader's grip. After a massive shootout and chase through the city, the team defeats the mercenaries and saves the accountant's daughter too. The accountant is reunited with his family, and Vanguard proves they are the best in the business. The movie ends on a light note, with the team heading off to their next mission, hinting that their adventures are far from over.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves action movies with big stunts and light comedy.
